action_history.rationale: Cold start with only 12 points in 2D. The yield surface is sharply peaked (median ~0.6 vs max ~99), so we need both exploration to map the landscape and exploitation near the promising region. Batch size of 16 exceeds 10, making Thompson sampling the natural choice: it provides diverse, well-spread batches via posterior sampling while still concentrating points in high-probability regions. No budget constraint, so balanced exploration/exploitation is appropriate. Matern-2.5 with low noise floor lets the GP capture the sharp peak without over-smoothing. No input warp needed yet in 2D with sparse data.
